summary: This is a routine Form 8-K filed by CarMax Auto Funding LLC and related entities regarding an asset-backed securitization transaction. On April 21, 2026, CarMax Business Services and the Depositor entered into an underwriting agreement with RBC Capital Markets and other underwriters for the issuance of $1.175 billion aggregate principal balance of asset-backed notes by CarMax Auto Owner Trust 2026-2. The offering is registered under an existing SF-3 shelf registration statement, with the notes expected to be issued on April 29, 2026. This filing represents an ordinary shelf takedown of asset-backed securities, not a special situation event.
